_comment: ElevenLabs plan rate. usdPerCredit = plan price / monthly credits (example: Starter, $6 for 30,000 credits = $0.0002; Creator, $22 / 100,000 = $0.00022). Set plan/price/credits to your own plan; the dashboard prices every call from this. creditsPer*: estimates used only when a response has no character-cost header (TTS ~1 credit per character on v2/v3 models, 0.5 on flash/turbo; sound effects ~20 credits per second; music ~ credits per second of audio).
